title: Light Chinese Beef Soup-Like Dumplings
description: A light and refreshing twist on traditional xiaolongbao, featuring a bitter and aerated broth. This dish is perfect for those looking for a sugar-free friendly option.
instructions: Combine ground beef, pork fat, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil in a mortar and pestle. Pound the mixture with the pestle until it is well combined and has a smooth texture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together beef stock, water, salt, and black pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch and a small amount of water until smooth. Add the mixture to the beef stock mixture and whisk until well combined.
Add the egg to the beef stock mixture and whisk until well combined.
Add the lard to the beef stock mixture and whisk until well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

To assemble the dumplings, lay a piece of dough flat and place a tablespoon of the beef stock mixture in the center of the dough. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes. Serve the dumplings in bowls and ladle the hot broth over them.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot and discard the solids.
Bring the broth to a boil and cook for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the hot broth over the cooked dumplings.
